mutations.description: mixtures grouped across organisms rather than within each one
mutations._note: The strongest row in the table. Grouping across species turns every multi-organism pool into a 'mixed sources' finding, which is both wrong and loud enough to train a reader to ignore the warning.

mutations.description: a genus/species refinement is treated as a contradiction
mutations._note: 'from Drosophila' on a 'Drosophila melanogaster' row is a genus naming its own species -- agreement written less precisely. NCBI gives them different taxon ids (7215 vs 7227), so the taxon check alone calls it a contradiction. This was a real false positive found while writing the tests, not a hypothetical.
